purpose: Govern how project canon changes when new sources, recovered context, stronger interpretation or contradiction appears, while preserving prior states and dates.
rule: Revision changes the current model; it does not rewrite what the project previously said or what historical sources originally meant.

revision_types.meaning: new detail without contradicting earlier canon
same evidence receives a new project interpretation
earlier canon was inaccurate or conflated layers
new model replaces older operational model while preserving history
claim no longer supported and is removed from current canon

propagation: mark prior state as superseded/corrected rather than deleting provenance
update comparative mappings only after owner changes
record unresolved downstream incompatibilities in Research Lab

versioning_context.note: Modern data stewardship emphasizes explicit dataset version tracking so changes can be compared and reused responsibly.

anti_patterns: copying one corrected claim into many owners
treating changed interpretation as changed occurrence
